elements.name: Speedometer & Cluster
elements.description: Hybrid digital/analog speed gauge with speed in km/h, gear indicator, rpm bar, electronic assist active indicators (TCS/ESC/ABS), and drift meter.

elements.name: Position & Lap Counter
elements.description: Displays current race position with podium accent colors (Gold, Silver, Bronze), total field count, current lap, and total laps.

elements.name: Lap Timer & Sector Splits
elements.description: High-precision timer displaying current lap time, last lap, personal best, and dynamic sector split time deltas (green = faster, red = slower).

elements.name: Mini-Map Radar
elements.description: Track overview with player and AI position pips, orientation vectors, pit lane route, and sector boundary markers.

elements.name: Compound Badge
elements.description: Displays current tire compound (e.g. Spliced Slick, Hard Compound, Wet Tread, Gravel Rally) and thermal state.

elements.name: Joker Lap Badge
elements.description: Rallycross tactical badge indicating required vs completed Joker laps (e.g. 'JOKER REQUIRED' in amber, 'JOKER DONE' in green).

elements.name: Pit Lane Alerts & Overlays
elements.description: Tactical 'BOX THIS LAP' warning when tire wear exceeds 60% or car health drops below 50%; speed limiter banner (60 km/h) in pit lane; service countdown overlay.

elements.name: Tactical Cockpit Hologram
elements.description: Vector chassis projection showing proportional geometry, engine placement, 4-corner wheel assemblies with thermal/wear status, and switchable kinematics/dynamics modes.

elements.name: Approaching Curve Helper
elements.description: Anticipatory curve advisory indicating corner radius, apex direction, braking zones, and rally pacenote severity (1 to 6).

elements.name: Opponent Nameplates
elements.description: Floating racer badges showing driver name, position, and gap time delta.

elements.name: Player Locator Aids
elements.description: Overhead chevron pointer, ground proximity aura, roof strobe beacon, and radar sonar ping for high-density pack clarity.

elements.name: Developer & Telemetry Overlays
elements.description: LIDAR raycasts (F1), checkpoint gates (F2), collision OBBs (F3), AI paths (F4), and real-time telemetry panel (F5).

hologram_modes.name: KINEMATICS
hologram_modes.description: Structural linkage mode. Depicts suspension wishbone / pushrod geometry, buckled fracture deformation lines, dynamic camber skew, and perimeter impact zone damage meters.
features: Buckled fracture line rendering upon severe impact
Wheel camber skew visualization under cornering load
Perimeter impact zone wear bars (Nose, Tail, Flanks, Corners)

hologram_modes.name: DYNAMICS
hologram_modes.description: Telemetry & suspension stroke mode. Displays 4-corner damper stroke capsules with real-time compression travel and dynamic Fz normal load transfer glow.
features: Dynamic Fz normal load transfer intensity glow

styles.name: Rally Pacenote
styles.description: Displays rally-style corner severity numbers (1 = hairpin to 6 = slight bend) with turn direction arrow.

styles.name: Severity Chevrons
styles.description: Projects sequential directional chevron arrows along the approaching corner trajectory.

styles.name: Disabled
styles.description: Hides all curve approach indicators for purist simulation driving.

color_schemes.name: Traffic Light
color_schemes.description: Green (flat out) -> Yellow (lift/caution) -> Orange (heavy braking) -> Red (hairpin emergency).

color_schemes.name: Synthwave Neon
color_schemes.description: Cyan -> Electric Purple -> Neon Magenta -> Hot Pink.

color_schemes.name: High Contrast
color_schemes.description: Pure White -> Bright Amber -> High-vis Yellow -> Stark Crimson.

color_schemes.name: Rally Stage
color_schemes.description: Fluorescent Blue -> Chartreuse Green -> Vivid Yellow -> Blaze Orange.

locator_aids.name: Overhead Floating Chevron
locator_aids.description: High-visibility floating arrow directly above the player's car, scaling dynamically with camera zoom.

locator_aids.name: Ground Proximity Aura
locator_aids.description: Soft pulsing circular ground glow underneath the vehicle chassis, highlighting position in pack battles and dust clouds.

locator_aids.name: Roof Strobe Beacon
locator_aids.description: High-contrast roof strobe light designed for extreme off-road mud and night racing visibility.

locator_aids.name: Adaptive Contrast Scaling
locator_aids.description: Automatically increases aura and chevron luminance when obscured by smoke, tire spray, or off-track foliage.

locator_aids.name: Radar Sonar Ping
locator_aids.description: Periodic concentric sonar pulse on the minimap radiating from the player's vehicle.

cameras.name: Close
cameras.description: Intimate follow camera with prominent car detail and intense motion sense. Best for precision karting and autocross.

cameras.name: Medium (Default)
cameras.description: Balanced follow perspective giving adequate forward vision into braking zones while preserving vehicle presence.

cameras.name: Far
cameras.description: Wide follow camera offering expansive tactical view of upcoming corners and competitor overtakes. Great for GT and high-speed circuits.

cameras.name: Overview
cameras.description: Static full-track overview camera fitting the entire circuit within the viewport in classic GeneRally style.
